decomposition: composite_z = cs_common_z + cs_relative_z (equal-weight mean over VALID sleeves; benchmark-weighted mean also published)
semantics: composite_z: dimensionless trend strength in volatility units (unbounded); cs_common_z: date-level mean over VALID sleeves (market-direction component); cs_relative_z: exact complement (relative trend strength). NOT expected returns, NOT forecasts, NOT probabilities, NOT weights, NOT Black-Litterman views. trend_score_tanh is a bounding convention (k = 1) kept for BL 1.0 comparability; *_unit fields divide by the structural constant 0.80 (unit scale under i.i.d. returns).
